svg.text: Floor 780 x 430, 6 mm. Side walls 2 x 780 x 160, end walls

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 2 x 422 x 160, 4 mm. Walls stand on the floor at its edges;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: the end walls fit between the side walls.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: Hand holds: two 90 x 26 slots in each side wall, 17 below the

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: top edge, centred 195 and 585 from the rear edge; round the ends.

svg.text: Brackets outside: 10 along the bottom joints (3 per side, 2

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: per end), 4 up the corners; M4 bolts, washers both sides.

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: 150 each side of the centre line, 50 and 730 from the rear edge;

text.font-family: IBM Plex Sans, Helvetica, Arial, sans-serif

svg.text: countersink them from the inside so the pad lies flat.
